job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
Love the thrill of winning new business? Take ownership and drive growth for an innovative tech business as a Business Development Manager.

This is a 100% new business hunting role focused on winning new partnerships across NSW. You'll have full ownership of your territory, a competitive base salary and uncapped commission potential.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Prospect, identify and close new hospitality business opportunities.
  • Build relationships with venue owners, operators and multi-site groups.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from outreach to negotiation and closing.
  • Develop a strong outbound pipeline through networking, referrals and industry events.
  • Deliver product demonstrations and tailored solutions to prospective clients.
  • Maintain CRM activity, forecasts and monthly sales targets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful client onboarding.
We're looking for a driven, commercially minded sales professional with:
  • Proven B2B new business development experience.
  • Strong hospitality industry knowledge or relevant technology or SaaS sales experience.
  • A demonstrated track record of exceeding sales targets.
  • Confidence engaging owners, senior operators and decision-makers.
  • Strong prospecting, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience managing pipelines and sales activity through CRM systems.
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach suited to remote working.
This is a great opportunity for a proven sales hunter to build a strong territory and grow within an expanding business

Apply now or send your CV to swatts@s2m.com.au / muneera@s2m.com.au or contact us on 02 8396 6800 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: SEO Specialist
job.description:
If you're an experienced SEO Specialist looking for the next step in your career then this opportunity is for you!

This is a hands-on, client-facing role where you'll manage SEO campaigns, develop optimisation strategies and work closely with clients to improve organic search performance.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Manage SEO strategies and campaigns across multiple client accounts.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and technical SEO audits.
  • Implement on-page, technical, content and local SEO improvements.
  • Monitor organic traffic, rankings and campaign performance.
  • Analyse data using Google Analytics, Search Console and SEO tools.
  • Present campaign results and recommendations to clients.
  • Collaborate with content and development teams to improve SEO outcomes.
We're particularly interested in candidates with:
  • 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally agency-side.
  • Strong technical SEO, keyword research and on-page optimisation skills.
  • Experience managing multiple SEO campaigns or client portfolios.
  • Proficiency with Google Analytics, Search Console and SEO platforms.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
  • Confidence communicating with clients and presenting recommendations.
  • Excellent organisation, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
This is an opportunity to take greater ownership of SEO strategy, work directly with clients and continue developing your technical and commercial skills within a growing agency.

Apply now or send your CV to brett@s2m.com.au / muneera@s2m.com.au or contact us on 02 8396 6800 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Performance Marketing Manager
job.description:
Want international agency experience without leaving Sydney?

A leading global digital marketing agency is looking for a Paid Media Manager to join its Sydney office. You’ll work closely with the agency’s Singapore team and report to a manager in Singapore, delivering high-performing paid media campaigns for international clients.

You can work hybrid from the Sydney office or remotely. If you’re curious about Singapore, there’s the option to travel there regularly, or to relocate down the track. If you’re happy staying in Sydney, the role works just as well. The role follows Singapore business hours, which are 2–3 hours behind Sydney. That means later starts and later finishes.

What you’ll be doing
  • Manage and optimise paid search and paid social campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Monitor campaign performance, budgets and KPIs to deliver strong client results
  • Analyse campaign data and provide actionable insights and recommendations
  • Identify opportunities for testing, innovation and automation
  • Collaborate closely with the Singapore team on high-quality campaign delivery
  • Support junior team members with campaign knowledge and best practice
  • Deliver campaigns on time, within budget and to a high standard
What we’re looking for
You’re a hands-on paid media specialist who enjoys combining data, strategy and execution to deliver results, and you’re comfortable in a fast-paced, accountable environment. You’ll bring:
  • 3+ years’ experience in paid media or performance marketing, ideally agency-side
  • Strong hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads experience, with a track record of improving performance against KPIs
  • Strong analytical skills, including reporting and performance insights
  • Confidence presenting results and recommendations to clients
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management
  • Experience with Singapore-based businesses or international teams is a plus
  • Australian or Singaporean, with full working rights
What’s on offer
  • $100,000 + super
  • Hybrid in the Sydney office or remote
  • International client work and exposure to a global agency
  • The option of regular Singapore travel or relocation, if that interests you
Whether you want global agency experience from Sydney or you’ve always wanted to try Singapore, this role gives you both options.

For a confidential chat, contact Brett Dickinson at brett@s2m.com.au or Muneera at muneera@s2m.com.au, or call 02 8396 6800
